mathematical.native_accounting_definition_A: sum across asset and each of 8 bar steps of q fixed by opening funded events * S before that price innovation; original OHLC threshold exits have economic effectiveAt=bar.end
mathematical.native_accounting_definition_U: sum positive parts of signed buy/open-exit/bar-end-exit credit relative to price at same economic at; bar-end reference is bar.close, NOT a verified reachable broker fill
mathematical.finite_pathwise_inequality: For long funded q at bar start, native modeled per-bar U_positive <= q*(high-close)+ <= q*sum_{j=1}^8(S[j-1]-S[j])+
mathematical.conditional_WEAK_population_inequality: E U <= beta E A, beta=kappa_down/lambda_min, for class predictable at bar open and with original frozen 4sigma mixture independent of prebar q; not full broker adapter
mathematical.per_step_numerical_quadrature: Independent Simpson 65536 subintervals, corrected after earlier kinks limited accuracy
